title: Booking and Scheduling
meta: Online booking with calendars, availability rules and automatic reminders for your clients. From $150, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Booking and scheduling that runs without back and forth
overview: We build a booking system where clients pick a service, see real availability and book without phoning you. You set opening hours, buffer times, holidays and staff calendars. Confirmations and reminders go out by email, and bookings sync with Google or Outlook calendars. You get a simple admin view to see, move or cancel appointments.

pkgs.blurb: A booking page with availability and email confirmations.
list: Booking page for up to 3 services

pkgs.blurb: Staff calendars, reminders and a calendar sync.
Paid bookings, packages and reporting for a busy business.

faq: Can I use my existing calendar?
Yes. Standard and Premium sync with Google Calendar or Outlook, so bookings appear next to your other events and busy times block new bookings. Basic keeps its own booking list.
Can clients pay when they book?
Yes, in the Premium package, through your own payment account such as Stripe. Money goes straight to you, and we do not hold it. Basic and Standard can link to a payment page instead.
Yes. Times are stored properly and shown in each client's own time zone, with the location's time zone made clear in the confirmation. We test across a few zones before handover.
Why build instead of using a booking app?
A ready-made app is often the better choice for simple needs, and we will say so. A custom build makes sense when you need your own rules, branding or links to other systems.
